omapdss kernel module contains drivers for multiple devices
each DSS submodule. The probing we have at the moment is a mess
doesn't give us proper deferred probing nor ensure that all the devices
are probed before omapfb/omapdrm start using omapdss.
This patch solves the mess by using the component system for DSS
submodules.
The changes to all DSS submodules (dispc
venc) are the same: probe & remove functions are changed to bind &
unbind
column2: and new probe & remove functions are added which call

column1: component_add/del.
The dss_core driver (dss.c) acts as a component master. Adding and
matching the components is simple: all dss device's child devices are
added as components.
However
column2: we do have some dependencies between the drivers. The order in

column1: which they should be probed is reflected by the list in core.c
(dss_output_drv_reg_funcs). The drivers are registered in that order
which causes the components to be added in that order
components to be bound in that order. This feels a bit fragile
probably should improve the code to manage binds in random order.
